name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
role: US Representative from Georgia (2021–January 2026); left the Republican Party in 2026
summary: A populist, hard-right Republican while in the House, she opposed abortion, gender-affirming care and gun control, and favoured immigration restriction and 'America First' limits on foreign spending and wars. From 2025 she broke with Trump on the Epstein files, Gaza, foreign wars, ACA subsidies, H-1B and AI preemption, and resigned in January 2026. Many standard policy questions (economy, institutions, constitutional design) are not covered by her recorded statements.

limit-guns.rationale: Her official site says she is committed to defending and expanding Second Amendment rights; she introduced a bill to abolish the ATF and said the government will never tell her how many guns she can own.

decide-locally.rationale: On the AI moratorium she wrote 'We should be reducing federal power and preserving state power. Not the other way around.'

abortion-legal.rationale: Her official site states her number one policy goal is to end abortion in America; she cosponsored pro-life bills.

more-religion-public.rationale: Described herself as a 'proud Christian nationalist' (reported); this comes from earlier years and her later stance on the label was not checked, so low.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Displayed a poster reading 'There are TWO genders: Male & Female' (2021) and said God created people male and female.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Announced a bill to 'completely eliminate' the H-1B program (medical field phased out over a decade, no pathway to citizenship); earlier voted against the ALLIES Act and sought impeachment of Mayorkas over the border. She criticised mass roundups as unrealistic, but not lower levels.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Said in 2022 'people are done with globalism', described the UN's aims negatively (2018 post), and voted against admitting Finland and Sweden to NATO (reported).

nation-first.rationale: At CPAC 2021 said tax dollars 'should just go for America'; in 2025 told NBC she is a torchbearer of 'America First' and said Trump should focus on domestic affairs.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Opposes US foreign wars generally ('get us out of this'), and voted for Syria troop withdrawal; she has not addressed human-rights interventions specifically.

open-borders.rationale: Sought impeachment of DHS Secretary Mayorkas over border security (2023), sat on the Border Security subcommittee, and moved to end H-1B visas.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Reported 2022-2023 statements: called climate change a 'scam', said warming and carbon are 'healthy for us', and urged defunding 'climate garbage'.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Reported as saying in 2021 she would impose strict tariffs on China; no broader statement on tariffs to protect domestic industry was found.

right-to-secede.rationale: Proposed a 'national divorce' between red and blue states (2021, 2023), then said she wanted 'a legal agreement' separating states more 'while maintaining our legal union'; mixed, not a right to secede.

accelerate-technology.rationale: On AI she said 'We have no idea what AI will be capable of... giving it free rein... is potentially dangerous'; specific to AI.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Told NBC in 2025: 'I don't see things through the party polls and the talking points; I look at the real problems and analyze them that way.'

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: April 2023 post (as reported) called climate change a 'scam' and said 'fossil fuels are natural and amazing'; this praises fossil fuels but does not itself call for expanded production.

elite-replacement.rationale: In 2018 she shared a video on 'the forced collective suicide of European nations' with the comment 'This is what the UN wants all over the world'. Her later position was not found; she has apologised for other past rhetoric but not for this.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Told NBC the Trump campaign was a referendum on behalf of Americans 'so sick of Washington, D.C.'; said she opposes the 'elite donor class' and 'neocons' running the party; called Ukraine's government corrupt (reported).

party-discipline-binding.rationale: In Nov 2025 she said she was 'not towing the party line' and not 'playing loyalty games'; she was removed from Freedom Caucus in 2023 and broke with leadership on the shutdown.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Voted against admitting Sweden and Finland to NATO and for Syria troop withdrawal (reported); no statement on ending alliances outright.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Her 2021 alternative to the Equality Act would let people sue the federal government if their religious rights are violated and exempt religious nonprofits; not specific to minorities.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: At CPAC 2021 opposed foreign aid; introduced legislation to abolish USAID (shown on her official site); called for ending funding of Israel's Iron Dome.

corporate-influence.rationale: In her 60 Minutes interview (Dec 2025) she warned of being replaced by 'big pharma, big tech, military industrial war complex' and the 'elite donor class', and said crypto donors, big pharma and big donors were still getting everything they want.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Signed the discharge petition for the Epstein files and wrote 'Americans deserve transparency'; specific to those files rather than a general legal right.

religion-illusion.rationale: Describes herself as a believer ('I don't believe in evolution. I believe in God.'), which contradicts the view that religion is an illusion.

holocaust-denial.rationale: In 2021 she invoked Jews being 'put in trains and taken to gas chambers' in a (later apologised-for) comparison and apologised after visiting the Holocaust Museum; this treats the Holocaust as historical fact.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Introduced the Protect Children's Innocence Act (criminalising gender-affirming care for minors, passed House Dec 2025 per Wikipedia), filed amendments against the Equality Act, and said she refuses to recognise transgender women as women.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Same record: holds that sex and gender are fixed as male and female, citing God's creation.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Said in 2022 'There is a war of good and evil going on, and people are done with globalism'; in 2025 wrote that 'Evil is being defeated by the hand of God' on Pope Francis's death (as reported).

defensive-wars-only.rationale: In 2025 told NBC 'We elected the president to stop sending tax dollars and weapons for the foreign wars', criticised US strikes on Iran ('not our fight'), and in 2026 criticised the Iran war.

student-debt-relief.rationale: In 2022 attacked the Biden student loan forgiveness program (as reported).

close-ties-china.rationale: Said she would impose strict tariffs on China and expel Chinese nationals loyal to the CCP (2021, reported); called Covid a 'Chinese-made virus'.

notes: Positions shifted in 2025: the most recent clear position was used. Earlier controversies (QAnon, 2018-19 posts, 'Jewish space lasers') were answered only where a statement's wording matched; she has said her earlier social-media posts did not represent her views and has disavowed QAnon. Wikipedia-sourced quotes are secondhand.
